items.title: Oil Hits $114 After Iran Strikes UAE | US Sinks 6 Iranian Boats | FPIs Turn Buyers | Opening Bell
items.description: US forces reportedly sank 6 Iranian small boats attempting to disrupt 'Project Freedom'. Iran would be 'blown off the face of the earth' if it targets US vessels: Trump. Around 50 commercial vessels redirected from intended routes: US Central Command. UAE intercepts 15 missiles & 4 drones launched from Iran, asserting right to retaliate. US markets fall on Monday: Dow, S&P 500, NASDAQ slip between 0.1-1%. US futures steady after major averages suffer decline overnight. US 10-year yields jump over 6 bps to 4.4%; 30-yr bond at 5.02%. Asian markets mixed; Nikkei 225, Kospi rise while Hang Seng falls. Brent crude extends gain to $114/barrel; WTI Crude at $104. Gold prices fall 2.6% to $4,524 per ounce. GIFT Nifty suggests positive start for Indian markets
